admin-layout.app_description_js_creator: Graphics of social network posts from your own templates – no AI, everyone in a private workspace.

permission-descriptions.view-js-creator: [recommended: always on] Show the JS Creator application in the admin - without it the application cannot be opened
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-view: Section Images: view the own templates and image outputs, folders and the library, download files
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-create: Section Images: create templates and folders, generate outputs, upload images and fonts to the library
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-update: Section Images: edit templates, rename and move outputs, folders and files of the library
permission-descriptions.js-creator-images-delete: Section Images: delete to the trash, restore, delete for good and empty the trash
permission-descriptions.js-creator-settings-view: View the settings of JS Creator: default quota and the overview of accounts (counts, used space, quota - never their content)
permission-descriptions.js-creator-settings-update: Change the default and the individual quotas of JS Creator
permission-descriptions.js-creator-view-logs: View the log history (audit trail) of JS Creator

retention-settings.hint_js_creator_trash: Folders, images and fonts in the trash of the workspaces; counted from the deletion (default 30 days).

js-creator-shared.quota_warning: Space is running out – delete files you do not need or empty the trash.
js-creator-shared.quota_full: The workspace is full: nothing more can be uploaded or generated. Delete files and empty the trash.

js-creator-outputs.subtitle: Generated posts in your folders. Only you can see your workspace.
js-creator-outputs.drag_hint: You can also move a folder by dragging it onto another folder.
js-creator-outputs.empty_text: Posts generated from templates are saved here – you choose the folder when generating.
js-creator-outputs.trash_note: A deleted folder is in the trash with its subfolders. After the retention period (default 30 days) it is deleted for good.
js-creator-outputs.name: Name
js-creator-outputs.error_name_required: Enter the name of the folder.
js-creator-outputs.error_name_taken: A folder with this name already exists here.
js-creator-outputs.error_name_taken_move: The target already has a folder with the same name – rename it first.
js-creator-outputs.delete_text: The folder and its subfolders move to the trash:
js-creator-outputs.destroy_text: The folder and its subfolders are deleted for good, this cannot be undone:
js-creator-outputs.empty_trash_text: Every folder in the trash is deleted for good, this cannot be undone.

js-creator-library.subtitle: Images, fonts and icons for your templates. Only you can see your library.
js-creator-library.open_original: Open the image in full size
js-creator-library.name: Name
js-creator-library.images_empty: The library is empty. Upload logos, backgrounds or photos you will use in templates.
js-creator-library.drop_hint: You can also drop images here.
js-creator-library.trash_note: Items in the trash are deleted for good after the retention period (default 30 days). They count towards your space until you empty the trash.
js-creator-library.upload_refused_text: Type not allowed or file too large:
js-creator-library.quota_full_text: The files do not fit into your space. Delete files you do not need and empty the trash.
js-creator-library.delete_image_text: The image moves to the trash:
js-creator-library.delete_font_text: The font moves to the trash:
js-creator-library.destroy_text: It is deleted for good, this cannot be undone:
js-creator-library.empty_images_trash_text: Every image in the trash is deleted for good, this cannot be undone.
js-creator-library.empty_fonts_trash_text: Every font in the trash is deleted for good, this cannot be undone.
js-creator-library.own_fonts_hint: Brand or own fonts – only you can see them. Every face (weight, style) is uploaded separately.
js-creator-library.font_license_notice: Upload only fonts you may use (the licence of the font must allow use in graphics).
js-creator-library.error_family_required: Enter the name of the family.
js-creator-library.error_family_chars: The name may contain only letters, digits, spaces and - _ . '
js-creator-library.error_face_taken: You already have a font with the same family, weight and style.
js-creator-library.curated_fonts_hint: 25 families with Czech characters, stored on our server (SIL Open Font License) – available in every template.
js-creator-library.sample_text: Příliš žluťoučký kůň úpěl ďábelské ódy
js-creator-library.icons_hint: Icon set for templates – colour and size are set in the template. Brand logos (social networks) are not included: if you may use one, upload it as an image.
js-creator-library.in_use_image: The image cannot be deleted, this template (or more) uses it. Replace it in the template first, or delete the template for good:
js-creator-library.in_use_font: The font cannot be deleted, this template (or more) uses it. Choose another font there first, or delete the template for good:

js-creator-settings.subtitle: Space of the workspaces. Nobody but the owner sees the content of a workspace – not even an administrator.
js-creator-settings.default_quota_hint: Space for the files of one account (outputs, images, fonts, trash included) unless it has its own quota.
js-creator-settings.accounts_hint: Accounts with access to the application and accounts that still have data in it. Numbers only – no names or content.
js-creator-settings.error_quota_range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 102 400 MB.

js-creator-templates.subtitle: Your designs of posts - open a template in the editor, change the layout and save. Only you see them.
js-creator-templates.trash_note: Templates in the trash are deleted for good after the retention period (30 days by default). A template in the trash still holds the images and fonts it uses.
js-creator-templates.templates_empty: You have no template yet. Start with New template.
js-creator-templates.format_hint: Elements keep their anchor and offset - e.g. a logo anchored top right stays top right. Then fine-tune it in the editor.
js-creator-templates.name: Name
js-creator-templates.error_size: The size must be 100 to 3000 px per side.
js-creator-templates.delete_text: The template is moved to the trash:
js-creator-templates.destroy_text: The template is deleted for good (cannot be undone):
js-creator-templates.empty_trash_text: All templates in the trash are deleted for good (cannot be undone).

js-creator-editor.load_failed: The template could not be loaded (it does not exist, is in the trash or is not yours).
js-creator-editor.narrow_screen: The template editor needs a screen at least 1024 px wide. The list of templates and the outputs work on a phone too.
js-creator-editor.smart_guides: Smart guides - snapping to the edges and centres of the canvas and other elements (Alt = no snapping)
js-creator-editor.no_layers: The template is empty - add an element with the buttons above.
js-creator-editor.overflow_cut: the text does not fit, it is cut with "…"
js-creator-editor.overflow_blocks: the text does not fit, generating will be refused
js-creator-editor.leave_text: The template has unsaved changes. They are lost when you leave.
js-creator-editor.limit_layers: A template can have at most 200 layers.
js-creator-editor.error_name_required: Enter the name of the template.
js-creator-editor.error_too_large: The template is too large (at most 1 MB). Shorten texts or remove layers.
js-creator-editor.conflict_title: The template was saved elsewhere meanwhile
js-creator-editor.conflict_text: This template was saved in another tab or window. Your changes cannot be saved. Load its current state? (Your unsaved changes will be lost.)
js-creator-editor.save_not_found: The template no longer exists or is in the trash.
js-creator-editor.nothing_selected: Select an element on the canvas or in the layers. Properties of the whole template are on the tab Template.
js-creator-editor.locked_hint: The element is locked - it cannot be picked on the canvas or moved. Unlock it with the lock.
js-creator-editor.anchor_hint: The anchor is the point of the canvas the element is pinned to (X and Y are the offset from it). When the format changes, the element stays at its corner or edge.
js-creator-editor.highlight_hint: Select part of the text and click - it is highlighted with two asterisks on each side.
js-creator-editor.fitting: When the text does not fit
js-creator-editor.auto_shrink: Shrink the font down to the minimum size
js-creator-editor.max_lines_hint: The text is shrunk first; if it does not fit even at the minimum size, it is cut, or generating is refused.
js-creator-editor.image_field_hint: The image is chosen when generating. The editor shows a grey placeholder.
js-creator-editor.cells_as_fields: All cells as fields to fill in
js-creator-editor.library_empty: The library is empty - upload the first image.
js-creator-editor.upload_refused_text: JPG, PNG and WebP up to 15 MB are allowed:
js-creator-editor.quota_full_text: There is no space left in your workspace. Delete files or empty the trash.
js-creator-editor.fields_hint: Fields are filled in when generating (in this order). A field is created at an element on the tab Properties and disappears with the last element using it.
js-creator-editor.no_fields: The template has no field yet - switch a text or an image to a field to fill in.
js-creator-editor.key_invalid: Key: lower-case a-z, digits and _, starting with a letter (max. 40).
js-creator-editor.min_resolution_hint: A smaller image only causes a warning when generating.
js-creator-editor.resize_hint: Elements keep their anchor and offset when the format changes.
js-creator-editor.safe_zone_hint: The safe zone is only a guide - the top and bottom bands are covered by the app interface
js-creator-editor.output_hint: PNG is lossless (good for texts and graphics), JPG is smaller (good for photos).
js-creator-editor.caption: Post text
js-creator-editor.caption_hint: Pattern of the text offered for copying with the output. The buttons insert fields - generating replaces them with their values.
